{{Quote|Once the first droid breaks out of that laboratory, all Naboo is doomed!|Dr. Nuvo Vindi|audio=NuvoVindi3.flac|<ref name="MoaTM" />}}
A '''laboratory''' on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was where [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] re-created the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]].

==History==
{{Quote|I suppose one can never have too many lab rats.|Dr. Vindi|audio=NuvoVindi1.flac|<ref name="BSV" />}}
The [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] was built in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. It was sponsored by [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], who later supported its refitting as a means of getting revenge on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" />

[[File:NuvoVindislaboratory.png|thumb|left|250px|Dr. Vindi examining his virus stockpile]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] was able to reproduce the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]], a deadly plague thought to be eradicated that [[Death/Legends|killed]] all living organisms. It was here he manufactured a large amount of the virus for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to be dispersed throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in special detonation devices.<ref name="BSV" />

The laboratory, which was located in the [[Eastern swamps/Legends|eastern swamps]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], was discovered by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] who reported it's location back to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] before being captured by Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces, led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|assaulted]] the lab with the primary objective of neutralizing the viral threat. The secondary objective was to rescue Amidala and Binks.<ref name="BSV" />

[[Clone ordnance specialist/Legends|Clone ordnance specialists]] were able to locate and disarm all but one of the [[Viral bomb/Legends|virus delivery bombs]] and in the ensuing commotion of the raid, one of the devices was detonated, releasing a deadly blue plague-ridden cloud. Republic forces were able to seal the base before any of the viral agent could be released into Naboo's atmosphere, but with the exception of Jar Jar Binks, all others were infected by the virus. Skywalker and Kenobi were safely outside the lab when it was sealed, having apprehended doctor Vindi before he could escape.<ref name="BSV" />

[[File:BlueShadowVirus.png|thumb|right|250px|The laboratory tunnels filled with the Blue Shadow Virus]]
As Skywalker and Kenobi went in [[Mission to Iego/Legends|search]] of a cure for the virus, [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] led what remained of her team, including [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and some clone troopers, to eliminate any remaining Separatist droids who were attempting to break out of the facility and thereby release the plague onto the surface of Naboo. They succeeded in destroying all remnants of battle droids before they could escape the facility, realizing they were likely sealed in their own tomb. However, Skywalker and Kenobi returned with a cure to the deadly Blue Shadow Virus and rescued their trapped comrades.<ref name="MoaTM">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>
